authority_order.description: Written operator corrections, scope locks, recovery packages, gate approvals
Mandatory services, advertising status, absence policy
Campaign count, logical directions, export model
Group boundaries, intent ownership, landing and ad ownership
ORCA production contracts, Triumph-derived laws, format contracts
QA repair packages, collision repair, workbook generators

A_operator_scope_lock.title: Operator Scope Lock
rules: Every mandatory service receives stable service_id, campaign representation status, owner group, landing mapping, absence policy
Classifier and repair scripts cannot silently change these fields
Any disappearance of a required service blocks export

B_commercial_seed_protection.title: Commercial Seed Protection
rules: Operator-approved direct commercial seeds are protected
Automatic EXCLUDE of protected seeds is forbidden
Removal requires explicit operator decision recorded in recovery or scope artefact

C_campaign_architecture_first.title: Campaign Architecture First
rules: Freeze campaign count, directions, groups, intent boundaries, landing and ad ownership before final semantic processing

D_group_viability.title: Group Viability
rules: Viable when distinct paid-service intent, at least one legitimate commercial phrase, ad, landing, safe negative separation
No arbitrary minimum keyword count

E_semantic_admission.title: Semantic Admission
rules: Every active phrase must justify paid service, hire intent, group ownership, informational alternative, and status

F_controlled_tests.title: Controlled Tests
rules: Require phrase-specific hypothesis, risk, group, ad, landing, lower bid, success and exclusion rules
No copied cross-topic hypotheses

G_inline_negative_limit.title: Inline Negative Limit
rules: Long inline-minus tails to rescue weak base phrases are forbidden without explicit evidence
Prefer rewrite, replace, exclude, or isolate

H_negative_architecture.title: Negative Architecture
rules: Negatives produced after final phrase ownership
Every negative identifies protected intent, competing intent, scope, collision and semantic-risk result

I_qa_authority_boundary.title: QA Authority Boundary
rules: QA may detect, warn, block, recommend
QA may not remove mandatory services, exclude protected seeds, merge approved groups, change campaign count or landing ownership, invent commercial scope

J_external_artefact_gate.title: External Artefact Gate
rules: Final XLSX must be independently reopened and audited
Internal PASS files are not independent proof

K_commercial_validity_gate.title: Commercial Validity Gate
rules: PASS requires service coverage, intent purity, group clarity, ad alignment, landing alignment, safe negatives — not structure alone
